answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with slashable collateral and a random audit called the falcon. Each worker locks a bond before bidding; the falcon picks identities at random and traces their funding to a common backer. Clones from one backer teeter on a narrow ledge: a single audit slashes every linked bond. Good reputation is a pearl earned over weeks and lost in an instant. An attacker wanting N fake workers must post N separate bonds and keep each funded, so the cost grows linearly with the size of the army.
